INFO: media.sound_label mirrors English's =1/other rather than hi's one/other. Count 0 is unreachable for this label, so the rendering matches English for every reachable count; moving to 'one' would depart from the source structure for no gain.

INFO: the commit message's '28 times' for ध्वनि is a near-count; measured here as 32 occurrences over 27 keys. Immaterial to the decision, recorded so the figure is not read later as an audit measurement.

INFO: no rendered frame was captured (read-only lane, machine near its RAM limit). Fit is argued from cell counts and the surfaces named in the sidecar; a rendered check of the player's control line remains QA/design work.
